primary_frontend: C: shared RootSIFT + frozen official LightGlue
frozen_geometry: MSAC1.5px; original PnP remains default; AP3P only explicit experimental candidate
reason: TUM quality ranking beats inlier ranking, while DTU/Middlebury favor inliers; no universal ranking. Exploratory AP3P improves TUM under both rankings and reduces some false/severe pairs elsewhere but lowers LightGlue DTU score; retain for review, no stable promotion.
secondary_frontend_caveat: RootSIFT-ratio B AP3P improves DTU but adds one severe TUM pair-seed position10->11. Do not infer frontend-independent safety.
safety_caveat: Original ranking harms vs fixed remain; AP3P is not a verified safe production replacement. Negative and partial runs remain recoverable.

decision.claim: candidate external validation only; no universal winner if tradeoffs; preserve both implementations

prior_selection.reason: LightGlue: inlier ranking weakly dominates quality ranking in scene-averaged score10 across all6 new sequences/objects; same or better reconstruction and false/severe counts. Differences are small or concentrated in a failure, not proof of universal stability.
